name: Uptime Kuma
description: Monitor HTTP/TCP/DNS services with beautiful status pages, alerts to Telegram/Discord/email.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3001"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    restart: unless-stopped
